settings.animations.note: Settings: label of the animation speed list.

settings.back.note: Settings: button back to the main menu, without saving.

settings.dice.note: Settings: label of the list of dice looks.

settings.dice_preview.note: Settings: screen-reader name of the six dice faces in the picked look.

settings.end_turn_ask.text: Ask before ending the turn while plays are left
settings.end_turn_ask.note: Settings: checkbox. On, End turn asks first when the player could still attack, buy or play.

settings.fullscreen.note: Settings: checkbox for a fullscreen window.

settings.language.note: Settings: label of the language list. Each language shows in its own name.

settings.mat.note: Settings: label of the list of mats under the game table.

settings.mat_preview.note: Settings: screen-reader name of the picture of the picked mat.

settings.nickname.note: Settings: label of the player's name field.

settings.save.note: Settings: button that saves every setting on the screen.

settings.saved.note: Settings: status line after Save worked.

settings.speed.normal.note: Settings: animation speed choice; the default.

settings.speed.off.note: Settings: animation speed choice: no animations.
